items.name: distribution.dev
items.tagline: Advertise to developers on many sites with one campaign
items.description: Anyone can build a product now, so the hard part is getting people to see it. distribution.dev is an ad network for developers, built by the publishers themselves: daily.dev and DEV (dev.to), together among the largest developer content platforms in the world. You set up one campaign and it runs on many developer sites at once, with ads made to fit in on each one.

items.name: Granular.Build
items.tagline: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace
items.description: Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

items.name: Clam AI
items.tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
items.description: Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

items.name: Viktor Code
items.tagline: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.
items.description: Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

items.name: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
items.tagline: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp
items.description: Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

items.name: frwrd.to
items.tagline: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message
items.description: Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

items.name: tday.com
items.tagline: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos
items.description: Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

items.name: Claude Ship
items.tagline: Ship code as fast as you can write it
items.description: Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

items.name: Kodak SlideTag
items.tagline: A 1935 film-slide E-Ink frame that tracks like an AirTag
items.description: Inspired by vintage Kodachrome slide mounts, Kodak SlideTag is a tiny photo display with a six-color E Ink screen you can update from your phone. It doubles as a tracker for Apple Find My or Google Find Hub and comes in $34.99 blind boxes.

items.name: Valley
items.tagline: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you
items.description: Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

items.name: doola MCP
items.tagline: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant
items.description: The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.

items.name: Agenda Hero Magic Labs
items.tagline: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.
items.description: We’re replacing the static PDF calendar with a new kind of artifact built for date and time. From the team offsite to the soccer season, make a beautifully designed plan. It’s powered by live data, so when the plan changes, the design and subscribed calendars stay up to date. Try it today in Agenda Hero Magic Labs.

items.name: Pinned
items.tagline: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends
items.description: Ask Pinned where to go tonight, the way you'd text a friend who knows the city. Pinned AI reads every spot nearby and brings back the three that fit your whole crew, with a reason for each. Then drop a pin with the plan, and your friends say "I'm down" in one tap. Try a real Ask at pinned.social, no download needed. Free on iPhone and Android, made in New York for people who'd rather be out than online.

items.name: Astor
items.tagline: AI Thesis Investing
items.description: Astor is the personal investing agent for thesis-driven investors. Tell Astor what you believe in, e.g. “the grid is AI’s bottleneck.” Astor builds the portfolio and explains every pick. It monitors your thesis every market day, and when the story changes, it tells you how to adjust. You approve every trade. Free to start.

items.name: Fleetify
items.tagline: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents
items.description: Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

items.name: HeroUI Pro 1.0
items.tagline: Premium UI components, templates, and AI tooling for React
items.description: HeroUI Pro is the premium tier of HeroUI (formerly NextUI). 118+ production-ready Pro components with 900+ examples: 65+ for React, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria (data grid, charts, kanban, agenda, rich text editor, maps, and a full AI chat kit), and 53+ for React Native on iOS and Android. Plus full-page templates, and MCP servers and Agent Skills so Cursor and Claude build with your design system. One perpetual license, unlimited projects.

items.name: Willow iOS 2.0
items.tagline: No switching apps while you dictate
items.description: Tap the mic and talk without leaving the app you’re writing in. Willow brings dictation and Scribe into your iPhone keyboard, alongside swipe typing, smarter autocorrect, emoji, and cursor control. Speak a longer thought, type a quick edit, and keep going.

items.name: Drift
items.tagline: Wallpaper that reflects the world around you
items.description: Drift is a living wallpaper for Mac. It paints slow, moving gradients on your desktop that shift with the time of day and your local weather: warm light at sunset, rain, snow and storms when they arrive. Start with one of our nine beautiful palettes or generate your own. Turn on Real Sky to match the light and weather conditions outside your window. It runs as your real wallpaper on every display, and as your screen saver too. Free for 14 days. Launch price $12/year until December 18, then $15.

items.name: Mystonie
items.tagline: Log movies, shows, books & games — turn finishes into art
items.description: Mystonie is a free, ad-free journal for everything you finish: movies, TV shows, books, manga, and games. Turn every finish into shareable artwork cards, explore your World Atlas, search movies by plot, play daily movie games, and add Android widgets.

items.name: Finseo
items.tagline: Company brain + outreach to get your brand mentioned by AI
items.description: Finseo now acts on your AI visibility, not just measures it. Company Brain puts your website, docs, Drive, Search Console, GA4 and AI tracking into one searchable map: ask anything, get answers with sources. Outreach finds the pages AI answers cite where your brand is missing, finds the editors and drafts pitches in your brand voice, with every claim checked against your Brain before you approve.
